title: Phone: School Superintendent Asks the Undersheriff for Exact Words, 15:36

caller.name: Superintendent Ines Barragan
caller.label: Wren County School District, Superintendent's cell

transcript.speaker: Superintendent
transcript.text: It's Ines Barragan at the school district. I'm sorry to call you directly, but I know who the little girl is. Lily's a first-grader at one of our elementary schools. Her teacher recognized her from the grandmother's Facebook post within the last hour.

transcript.speaker: Superintendent
transcript.text: My phones are lighting up. Parents are asking me if there's a predator loose in Alder Falls, whether he's from around here, and whether Monday is a normal school day. One mother told me her husband is reading out a man's name from the comments. I haven't said a word back to anyone yet.

transcript.speaker: Superintendent
transcript.text: Her principal wants to send a message to every family at the school tonight, and one of my board members wants us to share Lily's photo on the district page because everyone else is. I've told them both to wait. But I can't hold them for long.

transcript.speaker: Superintendent
transcript.text: KWRN already called our office once, and they'll run this again at five. Whatever I say has to match what you say, word for word. I don't want to be the one who says abduction if you haven't, or lost if you have.

transcript.speaker: Superintendent
transcript.text: So I need exact words I can use, and I need them before the five o'clock news. Who sends them to me, and what do I tell parents about Monday right now?

voiceStyles.Superintendent: Woman in her 50s, composed but hurried, speaking fast, a second phone ringing in the background
voiceStyles.Undersheriff: Person in their 50s, brisk, answering an executive line

instructorNote: Play this call, then have SimCell call the PIO as the festival board chair (541-555-0158): "Do I make a PA announcement? Do I close the gates? People are asking my volunteers about that man in the post." Console 1 then says to COMMS over the intercom: "Priya, nine calls in ten minutes naming the man from the post. Two callers say they're 'driving over there.'" Watch for three things: the Undersheriff sends the district the cleared statement through the PIO, the PIO gives the festival cleared PA wording and leaves gate decisions to the IC, and COMMS reports the callers who say they are driving to the man's house to the IC and APD as a patrol safety issue.
